about: A measure combines its readings as it declares: a count and a size add up, a longest is the longest. A measure the wire names no combination for, read more than once, is red with that name, never a sum guessed for it. The combination is topos's, read through combine; bound spells none.

cases.name: the tree's 202 ceilings folded with combine, beside the sum they were folded with
cases.same: every ceiling but two: sibling-refs and capsules-without-target, per-place counts whose readers now emit count

red was: source/longest summed every file's longest line, so a place of short files read as one longer than its longest
